description: This Java class `CreditBureau` represents a domain entity mapped to the database table `m_creditbureau`. It contains fields for name, product, country, and implementation key, and provides a static factory method to instantiate an object from a JSON command.

classes.name: CreditBureau
classes.description: A domain entity representing a credit bureau with fields for name, product, country, and implementation key. Extends `AbstractPersistableCustom` to gain persistence capabilities and uses Lombok annotations for getters, setters, and constructor generation.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a `CreditBureau` instance from a `JsonCommand` by extracting relevant parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
